clue.text: Coming out of foster care, one tells of what is to come

definitions.text: one tells of what is to come

indicators.note: the answer emerges from the letters of the two words, freshly rearranged

explanation.surface: A child leaving foster care grows up to predict the future.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Coming out of' signals that the letters of FOSTER CARE are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A forecaster predicts weather or events, telling people what lies ahead.

clue.text: Inevitable destiny of one of three goddesses

definitions.meaning: in Greek myth the three ... spun, measured and cut the thread of life

explanation.surface: The destiny of one of three mythical goddesses is sealed.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means unavoidable destiny and also names each of the three mythological Fates.

clue.text: Echo included in two songs making one

indicators.note: the letter for Echo is placed inside the two song words joined together

parts.note: a round and a lay are both kinds of song
Echo is E in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: An echo added to two songs merges them into a single piece.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one' means one song, the songs just mentioned: the answer is itself a song.
explanation.definitionFit: A roundelay is a short song with a refrain, so it is one more song.

clue.text: One cited in divorce describes Romeo as pen pal, perhaps

indicators.note: to describe can mean to draw around, so the divorce figure encircles the Romeo letter

parts.note: a co-respondent is the third party named in a divorce case
Romeo is R in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: The lover named in a divorce paints a Romeo as a mere letter-writing friend.
explanation.walkthrough: 'describes' here means goes round: CO-RESPONDENT takes R inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A pen pal is one example of someone who exchanges letters regularly with another.

clue.text: In haste, warden protects race official

indicators.note: the answer sits within the words that follow
the outer letters shield and enclose the answer like a guard

explanation.surface: A warden hurriedly guards an official at the races.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In' and 'protects' both say the answer is concealed across 'haSTE WARDen'.
explanation.definitionFit: Stewards are officials who supervise horse races and enforce the rules.

clue.text: Attempted to replant seed, say

indicators.note: planting the seed again in new positions means its letters, with those of say, are rearranged

explanation.surface: A gardener tried planting the seeds again.
explanation.walkthrough: 'replant' rearranges SEED and SAY.
explanation.definitionFit: To essay is an old, formal verb for trying or making an attempt.

clue.text: Prophet before noon so revolutionary

parts.note: AM, ante meridiem, means before noon

indicators.note: turning round, so the little word is read backwards

explanation.surface: A prophet active in the morning is thus a radical.
explanation.walkthrough: 'revolutionary' turns SO into OS.
explanation.definitionFit: Amos is a Hebrew prophet with his own book of the Old Testament.

clue.text: Nothing in film can make you tearful

indicators.note: the zero letter is set inside the word for a thin coating

parts.note: a film of moisture is a mist
nothing is zero, written O

explanation.surface: Even a film with nothing in it can bring tears to your eyes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'film' looks like a movie but is a thin layer, MIST.
explanation.definitionFit: Moist eyes are wet with tears, so moist describes someone close to crying.

clue.text: Ginger isn't rearranging piece of jewellery

indicators.note: putting the letters of the two words into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone called Ginger refuses to tidy up jewellery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rearranging' shuffles GINGER ISNT.
explanation.definitionFit: A signet ring is a finger ring bearing a seal or crest, worn as an ornament.

clue.text: Regret entering Turkey? That's more accurate

indicators.note: the word for regret goes into the country's code

parts.note: TR is the international code for Turkey
to rue is to regret

explanation.surface: Is it more correct to regret visiting Turkey?
explanation.walkthrough: TR is the international vehicle code for Turkey, not an abbreviation a solver may expect.
explanation.definitionFit: Truer is the comparative of true, meaning closer to fact or precision.

clue.text: Taking a liberty

parts.note: read literally, taking away someone's freedom

explanation.surface: Someone behaves presumptuously.
explanation.walkthrough: The idiom means being cheeky, but read literally it is depriving someone of freedom.
explanation.definitionFit: Enslaving a person takes away their freedom, their liberty, in the most literal way.

clue.text: Retold miracle about the very best yet

indicators.note: turned about, so the letters of both words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A miracle story told again is the finest ever.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Retold' looks like the anagram signal but is part of the fodder; 'about' rearranges RETOLD MIRACLE.
explanation.definitionFit: An all-time record is the best performance ever achieved up to now.

clue.text: Ready with it, prepared type of fibre

indicators.note: the letters are made up afresh into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Ready with fibre for a meal, prepared in advance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'prepared' rearranges READY and IT.
explanation.definitionFit: Dietary fibre is roughage in food, so the adjective names a kind of fibre.

clue.text: Large Italian male is agile

parts.note: L is the clothing-size abbreviation for large
a male person is he

explanation.surface: A big Italian man moves nimbly.
explanation.definitionFit: Lithe describes a supple, graceful body, much as agile does.

clue.text: Irresponsible sort? Bat perhaps

definitions.meaning: an unreliable person who may vanish without paying
literally, a creature that flies by night, like a bat

explanation.surface: Is the irresponsible person a bat, perhaps?
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase names a shady, untrustworthy person and literally describes a nocturnal flier.

clue.text: Lady having protection finding this on pond

parts.note: Lily is a woman's name, standing for a lady
a pad is a protective cushion, as in cricket pads

explanation.surface: A lady with a shield finds herself on a pond.
explanation.walkthrough: 'this' points at the answer itself, the thing found on a pond.
explanation.definitionFit: Lily pads are the broad floating leaves of water lilies seen on ponds.

clue.text: Vessel that's off-course?

definitions.meaning: a fishing boat using drift nets
one who drifts wanders without direction

explanation.surface: A ship has strayed from its course.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a type of fishing boat and an aimless wanderer.

clue.text: Miserly fool said to be closely connected

parts.note: tight is slang for stingy

indicators.note: spoken, the word for fool sounds like a word for joining yarn

parts.note: a nit is a silly person

explanation.surface: A stingy idiot is said to be close to others.
explanation.walkthrough: NIT, a fool, is spoken the same as KNIT.
explanation.definitionFit: A tight-knit group has members bound closely together, like firmly worked yarn.

clue.text: Fitting stabbing instrument

definitions.meaning: a ... fitting is a push-and-twist connector, as on a light bulb
a blade fixed to a rifle

explanation.surface: A suitable weapon for stabbing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fitting' reads as an adjective meaning suitable, but it is the noun, a type of connector.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a blade fixed to a rifle and a push-and-twist bulb connector.

clue.text: Soldiers in depot moved missile

indicators.note: the soldiers' letters go inside the rearranged word
the letters of depot are moved about

parts.note: OR, other ranks, means ordinary soldiers

explanation.surface: Troops at a depot shifted a missile.
explanation.walkthrough: The rearranged letters of 'depot' make TPEDO before the soldiers go in.
explanation.definitionFit: A torpedo is a self-propelled underwater missile.

clue.text: Shock, seizing engineer's weapon

indicators.note: grabbing hold, so the shock word wraps around the engineer

parts.note: to stun is to shock
ENG is short for engineer

explanation.surface: A sudden shock as someone grabs the engineer's weapon.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shock' looks like the definition of an electric jolt, but the weapon is the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: The Sten gun was a British submachine gun of the Second World War.

clue.text: Hotel surrounded by Scottish river thicket

indicators.note: the hotel word is enclosed by the river's name

parts.note: the Spey is a river in north-east Scotland
an inn is a small hotel

explanation.surface: A hotel beside a Highland river among the trees.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hotel' looks like H from the phonetic alphabet; here it is INN.
explanation.definitionFit: A spinney is a small wood or copse, a dense growth of trees and bushes.

clue.text: Touching way to give a reminder

definitions.text: Touching way to give a reminder

parts.words: Touching way to give a reminder
parts.note: a reminder delivered by physical contact, such as a poke with the elbow

explanation.surface: A heartfelt way of jogging someone's memory.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Touching' suggests moving or emotional; it means physical contact.
explanation.definitionFit: A gentle poke with the elbow is the physical prompt that also stands for any reminder.

clue.text: Remove concealed listening devices — and insects!

definitions.meaning: to ... a room is to sweep it for hidden microphones
read literally, to ... is to rid of insects

explanation.surface: Clear the room of hidden microphones, and creepy-crawlies too!
explanation.definitionFit: Bugs are both hidden microphones and insects, so removing either is to de-bug.

clue.text: Train me mending old clothes

indicators.note: repairing, so the letters are put back together in a new order

explanation.surface: Teach me to repair old clothes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mending' rearranges TRAIN ME.
explanation.definitionFit: Raiment is an archaic, literary word for clothing or garments.

clue.text: Say no to reduced incentive

indicators.note: cut short, so the last letter of the refusing word is dropped

parts.note: to spurn is to reject

explanation.surface: Turning down a smaller bonus.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reduced' takes the final N off SPURN.
explanation.definitionFit: A spur is a stimulus or motivation, from the rider's spur that urges a horse on.

clue.text: Pass through negotiator

definitions.meaning: to pass through the middle of things
a ... carries messages between two parties

explanation.surface: A negotiator gets waved through.
explanation.definitionFit: A go-between is an intermediary who mediates between opposing sides.

clue.text: Admit criminal now at university

indicators.note: crooked, so the letters of now are bent into a new order

parts.note: being up means in residence at university

explanation.surface: A student confesses to being a lawbreaker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'criminal' rearranges NOW into OWN; being UP is a British idiom for being at university.
explanation.definitionFit: To own up is an idiom for confessing to something.

clue.text: To Georgia, it's a loose outer garment

parts.note: GA is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Georgia

explanation.surface: In Georgia, people wear loose robes.
explanation.definitionFit: A toga was the draped woollen robe worn by citizens of ancient Rome.

clue.text: Imitative newspaper worker?

parts.note: a newspaper editor who copies, playfully reading the job title literally

explanation.surface: A journalist who imitates others.
explanation.walkthrough: Read as 'copy' plus 'editor', the job seems to describe a mimic; really it is the person who checks text.
explanation.definitionFit: A copy editor corrects and prepares articles for publication at a newspaper or publisher.
